title: Learning-objective-aligned Python MCQs generated with GPT-4
summary: Students can answer multiple-choice programming questions generated from course context and module learning objectives. GPT-4 generates each stem, answer key, and distractors; the reported work evaluates the items before classroom use rather than reporting a student administration.

sources.title: A Comparative Study of AI-Generated (GPT-4) and Human-crafted MCQs in Programming Education
sources.evidence_quote: Our work generates the stem, distractors, and key in a single generation step through GPT-4.

context.discipline: Python programming and introductory data science

course.name: Six higher-education Python and data science courses

assessment.summary: Answer MCQs aligned to module-level programming learning objectives.
student_actions: Read a programming question and select one answer from the supplied choices.

student_role.description: GPT-4 authors the assessment items; the paper does not report student use of AI while answering them.

assessment_system_role: Generate MCQ stems, keys, and distractors from course context and learning objectives.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.
